headline: The paradox of rising unemployment in Western Greece: the labor market has “hit the ceiling”
summary: Unemployment is falling nationally in Greece, but Western Greece has recorded rising jobless numbers for months, a trend described as a labour market that has hit a ceiling.
why: Regional labour market divergence affects consumer spending, public welfare costs and the investment case for local businesses.
